deadline.value: The PhD application deadline is January 15, 2027, for Fall 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: Our application deadline for the PhD Program is January 15th.

gre_general.value: The GRE General is waived for the 2026-2027 cycle, and a missing score will not count against anyone.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores will NOT be required this year, and their absence will not be used to count against any applicant.

gre_subject.value: The Physics Subject GRE is waived for the 2026-2027 cycle.
gre_subject.quote: Take the Physics Subject GRE (waived for the 2026-2027 admission cycle)

toefl_min.value: The department requires 100 on the original TOEFL iBT scale, or 5 on the new scale.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL score is 100 (original TOEFL iBT score scale) or 5 (new TOEFL iBT score scale beginning January 21, 2026)

ielts_min.value: The department requires 7.5 overall on IELTS.
ielts_min.quote: A minimum score of 100 (original TOEFL iBT score scale) or 5 (new TOEFL iBT score scale beginning January 21, 2026) on the TOEFL exam or 7.5 on the IELTS exam

supervisor.value: The pages do not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The graduate office promises five years of full financial support for full-time PhD students in good standing.
funding.quote: The Office Graduate Studies promises 5 years of full financial support for full-time Ph.D students who maintain satisfactory academic progress

entry_route.value: A bachelor's in physics or a related field is required, and applicants who already hold a master's are welcome too.
entry_route.quote: We welcome applications for the Ph.D. degree from students who already hold Master’s degrees
